convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'AML' custom indicator which has fractal dimension-based adaptive smoothing logic. The AML indicator is provided but requires manual Python reimplementation of its non-trivial algorithm (fractal dimension calculation, ring buffer smoothing, conditional line stepping). Trade logic is otherwise simple (market orders, single position), but the custom indicator dependency prevents auto-conversion.

derived_values.name: AML value - adaptive market level based on fractal dimension
derived_values.formula: R1=Range(Fractal,bar)/Fractal; R2=Range(Fractal,bar+Fractal)/Fractal; R3=Range(2*Fractal,bar)/(2*Fractal); dim=(log(R1+R2)-log(R3))*1.44269504088896; alpha=exp(-Lag*(dim-1)); alpha=clamp(alpha,0.01,1.0); price=(H+L+2*O+2*C)/6; Smooth=alpha*price+(1-alpha)*Smooth_prev; if|Smooth[0]-Smooth[Lag]|>=Lag*Lag*Point then AML=Smooth else AML=AML_prev

derived_values.name: Lot size with deposit-proportional scaling
derived_values.formula: if use_Multpl: Lots*AccountBalance/Max_drawdown, clamped to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX; else: Lots

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position and opens reverse when use_opposite=true: if long and AML inside bearish candle, close long then open short; if short and AML inside bullish candle, close short then open long

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if use_Multpl=true, lot = Lots * AccountBalance / Max_drawdown, normalized to 2 decimals, clamped to broker SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX; otherwise fixed Lots=0.1

custom_logic_notes: Entry condition uses AML value from completed bar (index 1, not current bar). Long: AML[1] >= Open[1] AND AML[1] <= Close[1] (AML inside bullish candle body). Short: AML[1] <= Open[1] AND AML[1] >= Close[1] (AML inside bearish candle body). SL/TP modification attempted up to N_modify_sltp=7 times with 1s sleep between retries. The AML indicator itself uses a ring buffer (Count array) for efficient smoothing across Lag periods, and applies a threshold (Lag*Lag*_Point) to decide whether the smoothed value steps to a new level or holds the previous value, creating a step-like adaptive line. The 1.44269504088896 constant is 1/ln(2) for converting natural log to log2 in fractal dimension calculation.
external_dependencies: AML custom indicator (aml.mq5) - must be available in MT5 Indicators directory
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol with 5-digit pricing, 730+ days daily or H1 data
python_conversion_notes: The AML indicator must be reimplemented in Python: 1) Compute Range() as highest-high minus lowest-low over count bars starting at offset. 2) Calculate fractal dimension dim = (log2(R1+R2) - log2(R3)) using the log2 conversion constant. 3) Compute adaptive alpha = exp(-Lag*(dim-1)), clamped to [0.01, 1.0]. 4) Calculate weighted price = (H+L+2*O+2*C)/6. 5) Apply EMA-style smoothing with adaptive alpha using ring buffer of size Lag+1. 6) Apply step threshold: if |Smooth_current - Smooth_Lag_ago| >= Lag^2 * Point, output Smooth; else carry previous AML value. Entry signals: AML inside candle body of previous completed bar. SL=500 points, TP=3500 points. Position sizing: optional balance-proportional mode. Single position per symbol with optional opposite-signal reversal.
